summary: Verified OHIP registration validation (backend+frontend), /register/dr-aguayo EN|ES language switch with persistence and translated errors, HC version-code letters-only, desktop DOB modal, physician Rx compact queue (no MEDICATION column) with med-count badges and detail dialog, staff Rx queue still has MEDICATION column, admin /internal/appointments loads, and patient portal /portal/appointments loads for john.smith. 13/13 backend tests pass; all requested frontend assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 844: identity_mod.valid_date is called on health_card_issue_date/expiry even for private patient_type where fields can legitimately be empty — currently fine because valid_date presumably accepts empty, but a defensive guard behind `if body.patient_type == 'ohip'` would be clearer.

RegisterBody.date_of_birth is typed `str` (not Optional); when the frontend omits it, Pydantic will 422 before reaching _register_missing. Tested path uses empty string which correctly maps to MISSING_FIELDS.
seed_data_creation: QA registration accounts created with qa.reg.<ts>@example.com were cleaned up from users+patients collections via pymongo during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_register_ohip_fields.py parametrizes OHIP missing-field cases (health_card_version, _issue_date, _expiry_date, dob, sex, address, city, province, postal_code, phone). The valid OHIP success test aligns HC issue/expiry day+month to DOB (03-10) — do NOT change to 05-01 because validate_hc_dates enforces that match. Private branch & /api/applications/new-patient both verified to NOT require HC. Physician Rx queue headers verified: SOURCE,REF,PATIENT,PIN,STATUS,RECEIVED,(open). Staff Rx retains MEDICATION column.
